title: Customization
intro: Change how Orbit looks, behaves and what it calls things. Privacy masking, SQL guards, readable contrast and reduced motion always stay on.

scopeHint.workspace: Applies to every device using this Orbit, unless a device chose its own value.

terminology.title: Names and terminology
terminology.intro: Rename any label in the interface, per language. Names of monitors, groups and layouts are edited where you register them.
